description: This Java class defines AddressMatcher, a custom matcher for testing purposes in the OpenMRS project. It checks whether a set of PersonAddress objects contains an address matching a specified string.

classes.name: AddressMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class for verifying if a set of PersonAddress objects contains a specific address.

methods.name: AddressMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with the address to search for.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if any PersonAddress in the set matches the specified address.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the expected address for test failure messages.

methods.name: containsAddress
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AddressMatcher for a given address.
